question: Should configured Discord role mentions become a supported one-to-many agent wake mechanism through a dedicated guild/channel role-ID setting?
rationale: The missing implementation seam is clear, but the feature establishes a shipped configuration contract and intentional multi-agent fan-out semantics that repository evidence does not authorize automatically.

options.title: Approve explicit role targets
options.body: Add a separate guild/channel role-ID list whose matched mentions count as explicit attention without changing sender authorization.

options.title: Consolidate access redesign
options.body: Move addressed-role semantics into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/69748 and make that broader configuration contract canonical before implementation.

options.title: Keep direct targeting
options.body: Decline role-based fan-out and retain direct bot mentions as the supported targeted wake mechanism.

recommendation.title: Approve explicit role targets
recommendation.body: Add a separate guild/channel role-ID list whose matched mentions count as explicit attention without changing sender authorization.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the adjacent Discord mention-filtering behavior whose explicit-attention and unrelated-role semantics the decision must preserve.
